reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because the speaker recruits viewers into OneCoin, calls it a life-changing opportunity, and directs them to contact him or join a leadership team; the description adds an educational-package entry route. The separately cited U.S. Justice Department source describes OneCoin's package sales and multi-level recruitment commissions. That compensation structure is program-level external context; the video itself gives the recruitment invitation but not a commission table.

citations.quote: One Coin is the opportunity of your life
JOIN THE MINERS' PLATFORM BY SELECTING AN EDUCATIONAL PACKAGE.
if you are from Mexico city you can contact me through WhatsApp or Facebook
If you want to be part of this great team of leaders, you' are welcome to onecoin

opening.argument: Judge the invitation by what it actually promises. The speaker calls OneCoin an opportunity, but his closing language is personal and tentative: he says he hopes to see viewers soon. The description identifies an educational package, not a stated return or guaranteed income. Promotional enthusiasm alone does not establish that this speaker promised viewers a financial outcome or misrepresented the terms of joining.

citations.quote: One Coin is the opportunity of your life
I hope that we see see you very soon
JOIN THE MINERS' PLATFORM BY SELECTING AN EDUCATIONAL PACKAGE.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opposing case rightly identifies enthusiastic recruitment, but its quoted contact invitation does not specify what viewers would pay, earn, or be promised after making contact. Nor does the educational-package description state a price or return. A life-changing pitch warrants scrutiny; those words alone do not establish a deceptive financial promise in this video.

citations.quote: if you are from Mexico city you can contact me through WhatsApp or Facebook
JOIN THE MINERS' PLATFORM BY SELECTING AN EDUCATIONAL PACKAGE.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The absence of a quoted guarantee is not a disclaimer or risk warning. The speaker calls OneCoin a life-changing opportunity, invites viewers to contact him, and welcomes them to its team; the description directs them to join through package selection. That is an active solicitation, even though the video does not state a price or commission schedule.

citations.quote: One Coin is the opportunity of your life
If you want to be part of this great team of leaders, you' are welcome to onecoin
JOIN THE MINERS' PLATFORM BY SELECTING AN EDUCATIONAL PACKAGE.

opening.argument: The description gives the most concrete account of what a viewer would select: an educational package. The speaker addresses people interested in entrepreneurship and describes the importance of being in the right company, at the right time, with the right people. Read together, these could be an invitation into an educational or business community. The video does not explain a commission structure, so its references to a team and leaders should not be treated as proof that viewers are being offered recruitment income.

citations.quote: JOIN THE MINERS' PLATFORM BY SELECTING AN EDUCATIONAL PACKAGE.
people with vision who is a responsible entrepreneur
you must stay in the right company at the right time, and with right people

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling viewers to a leadership team supports an invitation, but it does not tell us what that team does or how members are compensated. The opposing argument relies on a separately described source for the commission structure, while acknowledging that the video gives no commission table. The package wording leaves room for an educational reading of this particular message.

citations.quote: If you want to be part of this great team of leaders, you' are welcome to onecoin
JOIN THE MINERS' PLATFORM BY SELECTING AN EDUCATIONAL PACKAGE.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: An educational package is the stated route to joining, not evidence that teaching is the video's central activity. The speaker gives no lesson or demonstration in the supplied speech. Instead, he calls OneCoin a life-changing opportunity, asks viewers to contact him, and invites them onto the team. The educational wording does not erase that promotional purpose.

citations.quote: One Coin is the opportunity of your life
if you are from Mexico city you can contact me through WhatsApp or Facebook
JOIN THE MINERS' PLATFORM BY SELECTING AN EDUCATIONAL PACKAGE.

opening.argument: This can be assessed as promotion of a service with a stated package-selection route, without assuming a mechanism the video never describes. The description names an educational package; the speaker offers local viewers a way to contact him and invites them to join a team. None of those cited passages states a deposit amount, guaranteed return, payment for recruiting others, or a request for credentials. A recruiting tone is apparent, but the specific harmful transaction is not shown in the supplied video material.

citations.quote: JOIN THE MINERS' PLATFORM BY SELECTING AN EDUCATIONAL PACKAGE.
if you are from Mexico city you can contact me through WhatsApp or Facebook
If you want to be part of this great team of leaders, you' are welcome to onecoin

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opposing opening connects this invitation to a commission structure described outside the supplied video. Its own account concedes that the speaker does not give a commission table. The package sentence establishes a joining route, but neither it nor the contact invitation says that this speaker offers downline payments or guarantees earnings. Those missing details matter when judging the claim made here.

citations.quote: JOIN THE MINERS' PLATFORM BY SELECTING AN EDUCATIONAL PACKAGE.
if you are from Mexico city you can contact me through WhatsApp or Facebook

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The video need not recite commission terms to function as a recruitment promotion. It presents OneCoin as a life-changing opportunity, directs interested viewers to the speaker privately, welcomes them to a team, and supplies a package-based joining route. The absence of prices and payout details limits what can be inferred from the video alone; it does not turn this solicitation into ordinary, independently explained commerce.
